logMd:
### Round 1 - Track T5 (npm ecosystem)

**Date:** 2026-08-26. **Platform:** npm registry search API (registry.npmjs.org/-/v1/search), unpkg.com `?meta` tarball listings for SKILL.md verification, github.com for the vercel-labs/skills CLI. npmjs.com website itself 403s WebFetch; the registry API is the reliable path.

**Queries run (13):** `keywords:agent-skill` (101 total), `keywords:claude-skill` (281 total — only first ~250 examined), `claude skill design`, `agent skill accessibility`, `ux agent skill`, `design tokens skill`, `skill ux writing`, `user research claude skill`, `product design skill claude`, `figma claude skill`, `design review skill agent`, a `from=250` pagination probe on claude-skill, and `skills-npm`.

**Verification method:** for every candidate, fetched `https://unpkg.com/<pkg>@latest/?meta` — the published tarball's file listing — and recorded the exact SKILL.md path(s) and whether a LICENSE ships. This verifies the npm artifact itself, stronger than trusting the repo. License hints are inferred from LICENSE byte sizes (11.3KB ≈ Apache-2.0, ~1.07KB ≈ MIT) — texts were not read, so all are marked unverified.

**Candidates verified (17):** @adobe/design-data-agent-mcp (Spectrum design data, Apache-2.0-sized LICENSE), @design-intelligence/ghost (Block; brand guidance + advisory review), design-playbook (8 SKILL.md: ui-evaluator, ux-spec, craft-guard...), arc-a11y-skills (10 a11y SKILL.md), ultra11y (WCAG 2.2 + RGAA audit), unslop-preflight and vibe-design-md-architect (same author; design QA gates), overhaul-ui (29-command anti-slop plugin), sheleg-design-skill (design taste + 25 kits), dopod-design (Carbon guidance), ui-ux-pro-max-cli (6 SKILL.md + CSV design data), @double-coding/pixel-print (9 Figma-D2C SKILL.md), moodforge (11-agent design pipeline), singulariti (anti-slop + slop_detector.py), ui-ux-consultant-cli, arabic-native-localization (content design), @12ui/design.

**Rejections:** two mega-aggregators (claude-skills-library 1,128 skills; pm-claude-skills 1,117) as scraped catalogs; @mlllm/ui-ux-agent-skill-system because its published /skills directory is empty (17 skill names visible but no SKILL.md confirmable — GitHub verification queued); component/token libraries and SAP namespace noise as not-skills.

**New queries generated from findings:** the anti-slop cluster (unslop, singulariti, overhaul-ui) suggests searching `slop design skill`; the pp-* naming suggests `d2c skill`; `brand skill agent` for the press/ghost family.

**Not verified / inaccessible:** npmjs.com HTML search (403); @mlllm skill file layout; exact GitHub repo for arc-a11y-skills (author page only) and ui-ux-pro-max-cli (no repo in metadata); GitHub stars not collected for any candidate (would burn unauthenticated api.github.com quota — deferred to a GitHub-focused round).

**Saturation:** the `keywords:agent-skill` family (101) is fully covered; `keywords:claude-skill` (281) has ~30 unexamined tail entries plus a lightly-sampled middle; text-query space around design terms feels close to exhausted — the same ~25 packages keep resurfacing. Round 2 should: (1) paginate keywords:claude-skill fully and check keywords:claude-code-skill / keywords:agent-skills / keywords:openskills, (2) verify the 8 medium-priority leads (roast-my-design-system, @superdesign/cli, ui-pro-forge-cli, @getcoherent/cli, skillui, vanilla-core-ui, @frontify/fondue-sdk, @mlllm on GitHub), (3) mine skills.sh's design category and antfu/skills-npm's ecosystem, (4) note npm has NO user-research, IA, or usability-testing skills — those gaps must be filled from GitHub-native tracks.
